versions.changelog:
- Adds support for rewriting flagged prose using small local models via OpenAI-compatible endpoints, enabling offline or local model rewriting.
- Introduces `.rabbit-model` configuration file and environment variable support for persistent, automatic endpoint/model settings.
- Documents targeted chunking for minimal context requests, strict system prompt rules, and style presets (plain, TL;DR, 5-year-old).
- Ensures safe rewrites: all completions are verified for fact preservation and required edits, with automatic retries on failure.
- Provides quick setup instructions for popular local model servers (llama-server, Ollama) and benchmarking guidance.
